events.verdict: Gobert (MIN) leans into Sengun (HOU), but the contact is marginal and does not cause him to be dislodged from his defensive position.
Gobert (MIN) turns to roll and incidental contact occurs with Thompson (HOU) as Thompson commits to going underneath the pick.
Gobert (MIN) is in bounds when he makes contact with the ball.
Thompson (HOU) firms up in a legal guarding position in Randle's (MIN) path prior to the start of Randle's upward motion and is dislodged from his defensive position.
Smith Jr. (HOU) establishes himself in a screening position in Dillingham's (MIN) path and he does not deliver contact.
Sengun (HOU) briefly places his hands around Gobert's (MIN) torso before removing them and the contact that occurs is marginal.
Thompson (HOU) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Dillingham (MIN) prior to incidental body contact occurring.
Brooks (HOU) and McDaniels (MIN) come together in transition and the contact between the two is incidental.
Edwards (MIN) swipes down and avoids making arm contact with Thompson (HOU) during the driving shot attempt.

Gobert (MIN) turns and delivers contact to Sengun (HOU), affecting his ability to contest. Although Sengun grabs Gobert's arm in response, the first illegal action during the sequence is committed by Gobert.
Gobert (MIN) has an arm extended forwards and Sengun (HOU) lifts his own arm upwards into it, but the contact is marginal. Gobert then cleanly blocks the shot attemopt.
Gobert (MIN) cleanly blocks the shot attempt prior to when the ball reaches its apex or makes contact with the backboard.
Sengun (HOU) maintains verticality and absorbs the contact that occurs during Edwards' (MIN) driving shot attempt.
Gobert (MIN) and Smith Jr. (HOU) pursue the loose ball and marginal arm to arm contact occurs between the two.
Gobert (MIN) steps toward Sengun (HOU) to contest the driving shot attempt and marginal body contact occurs.
Smith Jr. (HOU) and McDaniels (MIN) engage and immediately disengage during the rebound.
Smith Jr. (HOU) briefly places both hands on Randle (MIN) during his drive, but the contact is marginal.
Brooks (HOU) gets his hand on the ball and any contact with Randle's (MIN) hand on the ball is incidental. As Randle regains full control of the ball, Brooks immediately removes his arm.
Gobert (MIN) places and then immediately removes his hands from Sengun's (HOU) back as Sengun spins away during the shot attempt.
Brooks (HOU) brushes Randle's (MIN) left arm during the dunk.
Randle (MIN) deflects the ball and any contact with Sengun (HOU) is marginal.
Sengun (HOU) turns in the air and initiates contact to Edwards' (MIN) body, which affects his driving shot attempt.
Alexander-Walker (MIN) commits a take foul on Brooks (HOU).

VanVleet (HOU) maintains a legal guarding position during Dillingham's (MIN) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Randle (MIN) and Sengun (HOU) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Brooks (HOU) briefly grasps McDaniels' (MIN) arm in pursuit of the loose ball.
